title: Final Headcount Volatility by Week
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:checklist`), seating revisions (`event:seating`), vendor contracts (`event:vendor`), deposits (`event:deposit`), planning syncs (`event:sync`).
app: Wedding and event-planning telemetry — The Knot checklist exports, seating-chart revisions, vendor deposit schedules, and RSVP operations — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor week_bucket=* headcount_delta=*
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(headcount_delta) as metric by _time week_bucket
| sort 0 _time week_bucket
description: Trends monthly headcount delta by week bucket for headcount planning.
value: Monthly trend lines show whether headcount planning are improving, stalling, or becoming unbalanced over time.
implementation: Normalize `week_bucket` on `event:vendor` events and store the fields needed to calculate monthly headcount delta.
visualization: Line chart of monthly headcount delta by week bucket.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges how headcount delta changes month by month for each week bucket so you can see whether headcount planning are heading the right way.
